answer_result.answer: Calvin invited his old high school friend—the same friend he had gone sightseeing with in Boston on 2023-10-24—to see him perform in Boston. The evidence states this was told to Dave on 2023-11-13, but it does not specify the show date itself.

question.question: Who did Calvin invite to see him perform in Boston on 13 November, 2023?

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-25, told Dave that the day before (2023-10-24) he had a great time sightseeing in Boston with a high school friend — "really fun and eye-opening"; he found Boston "a wonderful experience" with "awesome architecture and a really cool history," and said it was "so peaceful" — following Dave's advice (continuation of his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 Boston visit, see above; details in ## Relationships) [S26T1][S26T3].
- On 2023-10-29, while looking at Dave's Boston photos (the sunset-over-the-skyline photo and a close-up of the clock tower, see the 2023-10-29 entry in ## Music and the Photography section of /memories/dave.md), Calvin recognized the clock tower and said he was in Boston a few years back — "it's such a beautiful city." (a second, separate Boston visit, in addition to his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 visit above; "a few years back" — exact date not given) [S27T5][S27T7].
- On 2023-11-13, told Dave he invited his old high school friend (the same friend he sightseeing'd with on 2023-10-24, see above) to see him perform in Boston — "It was insane!" — (recent as of 2023-11-13; the show date itself is not specified) (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S29T1].

- On 2023-10-25, reconnected with Dave ("Long time no talk!"): told Dave he had a great time the day before (2023-10-24), visiting some sights in Boston with a high school friend — "It was really fun and eye-opening" (details in ## Boston trip); Dave: "Good to hear from you! Sounds like you had a blast in Boston - so much to do there!" and mentioned one of his favorites in Boston that's "great for chilling and admiring nature" (his Boston parks — details in the Boston and Parks sections of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "I had a wonderful experience during my time in Boston. It had awesome architecture and a really cool history. I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T1][S26T2][S26T3]. Dave then told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (details in the Car workshops in San Francisco section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!" [S26T2][S26T3]. The chat then turned to Dave's latest car project — he shared a photo (a group of people washing a car in a garage) and said working on this "takes me out of my head and calms me down" (details in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models." (details in ## Music) [S26T4][S26T5]. Dave answered that cars have "always been my thing": his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed" and "hooked," and wanted to learn more — now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (details in the Classic cars and Hobbies and sense of purpose sections of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music." — and shared a photo of himself performing in a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table) with someone he admires — "Check this out ... So amazing!" (details in ## Music) [S26T6][S26T7]. Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing! You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?" [S26T8]. Calvin: being "up there with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (Calvin's side in ## Music) [S26T9]. Dave: "That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us." [S26T10]. Calvin: it's awesome to find something that makes them happy — it's fulfilling and motivating too — and he's glad they're "on this journey together" and curious to see what happens next [S26T11]. Dave: "Me too, Calvin! Let's see where it takes us. We can keep inspiring each other!" [S26T12]. Calvin: let's "keep inspiring each other to be our best selves" and urges Dave to "keep going for your passion, buddy" [S26T13]; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Same to you! Keep pursuing your passion and keep dreaming. We got this!" [S26T14]; the chat closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying they'll "keep pushing for our goals" — "Catch you later, see ya!" and Dave: "Got to go, see you soon!" [S26T15].

- On 2023-11-13, reconnected with Dave: told him he invited his old high school friend to see him perform in Boston — "It was insane!" — it got him thinking about how far he's come and reminded him how important relationships are in the music business ("Felt so good!"); Dave: "Whoa, that's great Calvin! Seeing your old friend must have brought back so many memories. It's awesome to have someone who's been there since the start to support us." [S29T1][S29T2]. The reminiscing made him nostalgic — he and the friend used to freestyle as teenagers and talk about getting famous — "it's crazy how life has changed. But being around certain people still sparks those same feelings." — and he shared a photo of the two of them freestyling as teenagers (a photography of two men standing on a sidewalk with a car in the background) [S29T3]. Dave: "Wow, that's a great pic!" and asked whether that person made a big difference during the trip [S29T4]; Calvin: "He's been such a great friend to me. Always there to support and encourage me. His positivity has made a big difference in my journey." [S29T5]. Dave: "It's great how someone's support and encouragement can really shape our lives! They give us the motivation to keep going and trust ourselves." — and asked whether Calvin finds supportive people important for his artist development; Calvin: yes — "Having supportive people is key for me to grow as an artist. They motivate me to get better and stay true to myself. Having support is vital, especially in this tough music industry." (details in ## Music) — and he shared a photo of a group of people sitting around a desk [S29T6][S29T7]. Dave: "Wow, Calvin! Is this a pic of some musicians you're collaborating with?" — unanswered in this excerpt [S29T8]. The chat then continued: Calvin told Dave he's been supporting some young musicians from a music program — supporting their passion is amazing and their enthusiasm is inspiring (details in ## Music); Dave: "Wow, Calvin, that's amazing! You're really making a difference by supporting the next generation of musicians. It's great to nurture their passion and help them thrive." [S29T9][S29T10]. Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! It's like a torch being passed to keep music alive! These young musicians are very ambitious, I think I will support them for a long time." (Dave: "Yeah, Calvin! Your support for them keeps the music going and passes on the legacy. That's so awesome!") [S29T11][S29T12]. Calvin: "I'm stoked I made a difference. Paying it forward, ya know? Working with new talent brings new ideas to this." — and shared a photo of himself making a beat for a young artist (a photo of a man sitting at a desk in front of a computer), saying the artist has great potential in music [S29T13]. Dave: "Wow, that's cool! Your music studio looks great. Have you tried out any new ideas lately?"; Calvin: he's having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries — "It's great to go for new ideas and see where it takes me - always gotta stay ahead in this." (details in ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)); Dave: "Awesome, Calvin! Experimenting and pushing boundaries is key to making our art grow. Can't wait to see where these new ideas take you!" [S29T14][S29T15][S29T16]. Calvin: "Yeah, it's exciting to see where these new ideas lead. It's all about growing and evolving!" and signed off — "Have a good one. I need to go now. Take care, Dave!"; the chat closed with Dave: "For sure, Calvin! Growing and evolving is key for any artist. Don't stop pushing yourself and keep exploring. Can't wait to see what you come up with next! See ya Cal! Take care!" (Calvin's closing "growing and evolving" remark also in ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S29T17][S29T18].
